# Behavioral protocol compatibility pointer

Read the mandatory [shared behavioral candidate challenge](../_kit/shared/bug-hunter.md) and [common review policy](../_kit/shared/review-policy.md). They own Hunter -> Skeptic -> Referee, actual role/run provenance or disclosed local fallback, inline RoleDisposition, counter-evidence, depth and missing/malformed/no-candidate handling for both reviewers. Do not maintain another protocol body here.

The common adaptation remains pinned to Bug Hunter commit `3be69733a27aa04d4f5620df203c05350d162067`, v3.2.0. The original [local MIT license notice](bug-hunter-LICENSE.txt) is retained unchanged for compatibility; the [shared MIT license](../_kit/shared/bug-hunter-LICENSE.txt) accompanies the canonical protocol. No Fixer, dependency installation, executable repro/app tests/SQL or source mutation follows from artifact review.
